reason: The problem is real, I spent today driving 60 km for one paper, but I am not paying 900 EUR to a part-time developer whose only client is still in a pilot and cannot even take my phone call yet. My clients are farmers in Bihor; half of them will still call me instead of clicking a WhatsApp link, and the guarantee only covers the setup fee, not the months I spend teaching them.
objection: There is nobody in Romania I can call who uses this and got results. 'Available after the 60-day pilot' means the proof does not exist today, and a man doing this 10-12 hours a week next to a day job can disappear the week before a submission deadline.
would_change_my_mind: A phone call with the Bihor grant consultant, after his pilot, telling me his farmer clients actually used the link and his chasing time dropped; then I would try it for one submission round.
